name: First User End-to-End Validation

blocking_defects.summary: Structured Analysis originally failed before the LLM call because a historical migration-version collision left action_plan_snapshots absent while version 008 was already recorded. Additive migration 014 repaired the missing table/index, readiness was hardened, and production service recovery passed.

After schema repair, Structured Analysis reached the configured Qwen provider but full non-streaming analysis timed out. The targeted production fix disables thinking only for qwen3.8 structured-analysis requests while preserving other model behavior and connection testing, and the first-user A06 rerun passed.

Strategic Reply originally returned no supporting recommendations and an empty editable draft even though A07 passed. The repair reuses the conversation-level evidence-backed recommendation chain, adds a dedicated Strategic Reply generation boundary, validates recommendation/evidence provenance, and retains explicit user send/persist boundaries. The first-user production rerun passed.

usability_findings.summary: Registration UI does not expose username/password validation rules and reduces structured HTTP 422 validation details to a generic HTTP 422 message.

notes: A01-A05 passed for account/provider/canonical relationship data/evidence timeline using real first-user data.
A06 originally exposed schema drift and Qwen3.8 default-thinking latency blockers; both were repaired, CI-validated, deployed, and first-user reruns passed.
A07 passed Strategy/Recommendation with evidence-backed output and no automatic selection/execution.

A08 originally exposed an empty Strategic Reply generation chain; the dedicated evidence-backed reply generation repair passed CI, production deployment, and first-user rerun including edit/restore/copy.
A09 passed: the first user explicitly sent the selected Strategic Reply through the real external communication channel; the application did not perform or simulate the send.
A10 passed: Prepare sent-message record populated the canonical Message composer while remaining local-only and unsaved until explicit Add message.
A11 passed: the sent message was explicitly persisted through the canonical Message API, appeared in Evidence/Timeline, and no duplicate Message was reported after refresh.

Phase A is complete: real evidence -> Structured Analysis -> Strategy/Recommendation -> Strategic Reply -> real external send -> explicit Message handoff -> canonical Message -> Evidence/Timeline closure all passed in production.
B01 passed: a genuine incoming response was added to the same canonical Conversation as sender=person.
B02 passed: Structured Analysis was rerun after the genuine incoming response, returned non-empty analysis, included the new evidence, and no cross-scope contamination was reported.

No username, password, API key, real name, relationship detail, private chat content, conversation identifier, evidence identifier, model-generated private analysis text, strategy text, recommendation text, or reply text is recorded in this UAT artifact.
Real relationship and chat content remains in the production database and is not committed to GitHub.
TEST-156 is not yet VERIFIED. Phase B is in progress using genuine real-world follow-up evidence.
Next Phase B step is B03 Action Plan. Generation is explicit and may persist a proposed Action Plan snapshot; it must not create a user decision or execute an action automatically.
